item.description:
Aside 1.8.2

a bugfix release, mostly about notes that went missing and a few things around recording, teams and licenses.

recording and dictation

  • the recording pill and its card no longer vanish mid meeting if you close and reopen the card in the same moment.
  • if the recording stops on its own, the note says so above the summary instead of looking complete.
  • a meeting that failed to save keeps its retry button, even when the next recording has already started.
  • a dictation you left running is finished and pasted before a meeting recording starts, so it can no longer paste the meeting into your next app.
  • a dictation you cancelled no longer runs into the next one and turns it into garbage.
  • someone who talks for a long time without pausing gets a proper voice print, and one failed print no longer drops the speech queued behind it.

notes and sync

  • a note whose share never made it out of the app is picked up again on the next sweep instead of staying missing on your phone.
  • a note aside could not read for a moment is no longer deleted from the server and your phone. it has to really be gone from the vault.
  • duplicating a note in finder gives the copy its own sync id, so it actually reaches your phone.
  • a shared note that failed to download or failed to write is fetched again on the next sync instead of being lost for good.
  • if a teammate deletes a note you edited, your version is kept beside it as a conflicted copy.
  • links in a note that would open another app now show the real target and ask first. web links, addresses and files work as before.
  • connecting your iphone no longer hands the pairing secret to anything else on the same network. a device that finds you that way waits for your ok.
  • names from a calendar invite are handed to the model as names, not as part of the instructions, and only meetings you organised teach aside how you spell your own name.

teams

  • joining a team stops with a clear message if the old personal sync marker cannot be cleared, instead of publishing your whole vault to the team.
  • the recovery kit is the only thing that can restore a team now, not the team key every member holds. existing teams need a new kit for that route, and settings says so.
  • after an emergency recovery the team is told, with the date, so nobody misses that the old sheet still opens the team.
  • the recovery kit row only offers its button to admins, because only an admin may retire a kit.
  • the recovery kit pdf is saved so only your own account on the mac can read it.

license and aside cloud

  • when your subscription renews, aside cloud comes back on by itself instead of leaving you on a fallback you never picked.
  • activating an older key from an earlier mail can no longer shorten a term you already paid for.
  • on a busy day a subscriber gets a message about the daily cap instead of being told to add their own api key.
  • a transcript that is too big is turned away without costing one of your free calls.

under the hood

  • recovery challenges are cleaned up and capped, so nobody can grow the server database by asking for them.
  • if agent access cannot open its port, the reason stands in settings under the switch instead of the switch just claiming to be on.
  • the api spec matches what the recovery route actually does.
